identity_rationale: Walter Benjamin, identified by On the Concept of History (composition) and Das Passagen-Werk (posthumous; edited by Rolf Tiedemann). Existing curated person ID reused; no new authority ID or namesake merger.

sources.note: New rereading of theses I–XV, especially II–III, VI–IX and XII–XIV, in Dennis Redmond’s 2005 translation. sources.note: Institutional biography gives 1892–1940 and describes death during the night of 26/27 September; heading uses 27 September. Other accounts use 26 September, so this record preserves only the supported death year.

substantive_relations.relationship: Challenges homogeneous progressive time and the inheritance of culture through the victors of history.
substantive_relations.note: Own theses VI–IX and XIII–XIV read; this is a contribution associated with Frankfurt critical inquiry, not institutional membership or a single Frankfurt doctrine.

substantive_relations.relationship: Makes remembrance of silenced and oppressed predecessors a demand on historical representation.
substantive_relations.note: Own theses II–III, VI and XII read. A conceptual resource, not a title-based claim of influence on every later memory historian; separate specific reception evidence remains unchanged.

limits: Selected theoretical contributions and dated texts, with original, revised, translated and posthumous forms distinguished. Source notes state actual reading extent; no complete monograph or comprehensive reception survey is claimed. Existing collective relationships and source/roster qualifications remain.
